meta.title: A document is waiting for you | Everstead

title: {{name}} sent you a document.
titleNoSender: A document is waiting for you.

start.intro: Before anything opens, we send a six-digit code to {{hint}}, the address this was sent to. The link alone opens nothing, so a forwarded email cannot.
start.signInHint: If you already keep an Everstead vault, sign in and it can go straight in.

code.sent: Sent to {{hint}}. It expires in ten minutes. Check the spam folder if it is not there within a minute.
code.label: Six-digit code

signedIn.lead: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accept it and it goes into this vault. It stays yours, including if you later leave the organisation that sent it.
signedIn.needsCode: This was sent to {{hint}}, which is not yet an address on your account. Confirm you can read that inbox and we add it to this account, so the next one from them arrives without a code.

ready.lead: Confirmed. Two honest ways to take it.

keep.title: Keep it in a free vault
points: Yours to keep, including after you leave them
They can see that it arrived, and nothing you keep
No card, and you can delete everything at any time

download.title: Just download it
points: The sender sees only that it arrived

accepted.title: It is in your vault.
accepted.body: You own this document now. {{sender}} can see that it arrived, and nothing else.
accepted.auto: Taking you there in a moment.

downloaded.title: Downloaded.
downloaded.body: It is yours. Nothing was stored with Everstead, and the sender can see only that it arrived.
downloaded.cta: Keep the next one in a free vault

declined.title: Declined.
declined.body: Nothing was added anywhere, and the file has been deleted.

expired: This one has expired or has already been answered. Ask whoever sent it to send it again.

sees.title: What {{sender}} can see
sees.body: That it arrived, and when. Not what else is in your vault, not who else you share with, and never the contents of anything you did not choose to show them.

keep.title: What you keep
keep.body: The document, for as long as you want it. If you leave the organisation it stays yours, and you can end their connection from your vault at any time.

never.title: What we never do
never.body: Attach a file to an email, or open anything before you have confirmed a code. If you were not expecting this, decline it and write to hello@everstead.care.

safety: Everstead never attaches a file to an email, and this page never opens one until you have confirmed a code. If you were not expecting this, decline it and tell us at hello@everstead.care.
footer: Everstead, the place your family can find everything.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

missing.title: This link is no longer valid.
missing.body: It may have already been used, or the organisation may have withdrawn it. Ask them to send it again.
